plugin.name: Grok Usage
actions.grok-usage.name: Grok Usage
grok-usage.api-key.title: xAI API key
grok-usage.api-key.subtitle: From console.x.ai -> API Keys. Stored locally in this key's settings.
grok-usage.base-url.title: API base URL
grok-usage.base-url.subtitle: Only change this if you're using a proxy in front of the xAI API
grok-usage.model.title: Model to probe
grok-usage.model.subtitle: Rate limits are per model - pick the one you actually use, e.g. "grok-4-fast"
grok-usage.metric.title: Ring metric
grok-usage.metric.subtitle: Which rate limit to show as the percentage/ring: requests-per-window or tokens-per-window
grok-usage.refresh.title: Refresh interval (seconds, min. 30)
grok-usage.refresh.subtitle: Every refresh makes one tiny, real (paid) request against the xAI API - don't set this too low
grok-usage.show-remaining.title: Show remaining count instead of reset time
grok-usage.show-remaining.subtitle: Bottom label shows the raw remaining requests/tokens instead of the time left until the window resets
